author: ClubberNugget
body: We were in the cave mining when we were by lava, he mined beneath me and i jumped away thinking it was just an accident, he then continued to break blocks beneath me in order to drop me into the lava, i started stacking up to get elevation but he continued to break the blocks beneath me as i climbed and eventually i fell and died, i do not have a screenshot of him doing the spleefing but i have a screenshot of the update on the chat.  Thank you for your time to read this.
